name: HBEL 5357
title: Social Gerontology
description: Considers the societal aspects of aging, including the social psychological concomitants of adjustments, changing roles, and systems of social relationships. Includes an overview of the economic aspects of aging and the service delivery system. Required course for Substantive Area: Focused Area of Study on Social Work Practice with Older Adults.
requirement_description: Open to students in both the MSW program and the STEP program.
